fusions.name: Mudbank Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges from where you sat for 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that from 5 tiles away, and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of its health the target still has, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Clutch Ambush
fusions.desc: A clamping bite of the beak that deals 30 damage as a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Sitting Tight
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 25% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Brood
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
